name: Commerce Barion Payment
description: Barion payment gateway for Drupal Commerce, verifying payment state via Barion's authenticated API.
project_description:
Barion is the payment / POS company making commerce easy and accessible to everyone. This module integrates with their Barion Payment Gateway for online payments into Drupal Commerce.

 Barion Payment Zrt. (established in 2015) holds an Electronic Money Issuer licence (from the Hungarian National Bank) and can serve customers across the EEA through passporting without any further licence.

 This payment gateway increases conversion rate by significantly reducing checkout abandonments. It works on any device regardless of screen size, operation system or browser.

 We developed this module in order to ensure easier and cost less implementation of Barion Smart Gateway.
